description: Language-neutral operations invoked through the driver protocol. Arguments and values are JSON; counters are canonical decimal strings, never numbers. Value shapes are the JSON projection of the named schema/ GraphQL types with every selected field present (null when absent).

route.initialize.description: Fetch and verify the project's signed route. Backend clients only verify it.
route.initialize.returns: user: the verified route proof (SignedProof scalar: projectId, incarnation, servingEpoch, communicationBase, wssUrl, expiresAt, signature); backend: null

principals.create.description: Create a principal for an external user identity.

arguments.externalUserId: Customer-owned identifier; scenarios use synthetic values.

sessions.issue.description: Issue a short-lived user session token for a principal and device.

arguments.requestedTtlMs: Requested lifetime as a canonical decimal string (1000..86400000).

conversations.create.description: Create a conversation with an initial member list.

arguments.input: { title, props: object, members: [{ principalId, role }] }
arguments.requestId: Idempotency key (UUID). Omitted means the SDK generates one.

conversations.get.description: Read a conversation. User clients also receive their own membership.
conversations.get.returns: Conversation (membership is null for backend clients)

members.list.description: Read one page of conversation members ordered by principalId.

arguments.limit: Integer page size (1..1000). Targets may cap it lower.

members.add.description: Add or update members with optimistic revisions.

arguments.members: [{ principalId, role, expectedRevision }] where expectedRevision is a counter string ("0" for a new member).

messages.send.description: Send a text message as the client's principal.

arguments.requestId: Idempotency key (UUID). Omitted means the SDK generates one.

messages.send.returns: MessageAck { messageId, conversationId, sequence, revision, status, cursor: Cursor }

messages.list.description: Read one page of messages, newest first.

arguments.beforeSequence: Exclusive upper bound; pass the previous page's nextCursor.

messages.edit.description: Replace a message's text, conditional on the message revision passed in.

arguments.message: A Message value previously returned by messages.list or messages.edit.

messages.delete.description: Delete a message, conditional on the message revision passed in.

arguments.message: A Message value previously returned by messages.list or messages.edit.

events.list.description: Read one page of conversation events in ascending sequence order.

arguments.after: Exclusive Cursor { incarnation, conversationId, sequence }; pass the previous page's nextCursor.

events.list.returns: EventPage { items: [Event], complete, refreshRequired, nextCursor: Cursor }

requests.resolve.description: Ask the authority what happened to a mutation request id.
requests.resolve.returns: RequestResolution { state: notObservedYet | committed | accepted, requestId, checkedAt, resultWithheld, receipt }

requests.retry.description: Resolve a request id and, only when it was not observed, resend the original payload under the same id.

backendKeys.issue.description: Request a scoped backend key for a project. The secret is delivered out of band.
backendKeys.issue.returns: IssueBackendKeyReply receipt envelope { status: accepted, requestId, operation, resourceRef, ... }
